name: Vicegerency
overview: Scripture reveals the principle of vicegerency as the delegated authority Christ grants to His servants, particularly the apostles, to exercise binding and loosing on earth with heavenly confirmation. This divine empowerment, illustrated in Matthew 16:19 and 18:18, and affirmed in John 20:23, underscores the responsibility given to God's representatives to administer spiritual governance, including the remission and retention of sins. Such authority reflects God's sovereign rule extended through chosen individuals, as seen in the ministry of Elisha and the apostles.
